title: 第822章 我也和夫君一起来助你第821章 青鸾宗人此人不简单
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
对方说还有几个朋友，不管这朋友是真是假，至少说明附近还有他们的同伙。
在没有搞清楚对方人数和实力之前，贸然动手不是明智之举。
“既然如此，那咱们也算是同路之人了。”姜玄脸上堆起温和的笑容。
“二位不介意的话，我们师兄弟几个也帮着搜寻一番？多个人多份力，若是真有邪祟藏在此地，也好彼此有个照应。”
叶天澜看了他一眼，嘴角微微扬起。
“好啊，那就有劳姜兄了。”
姜玄点头笑了笑，转过身去招呼身后的师弟们。
就在转身的那一瞬间，他眼底闪过一丝冷笑。
彼此照应？
他不过是想把这对男女放在眼皮子底下，省得他们在暗处坏了自己的事。
至于其他几人，此刻见自家师兄主动提出同行，只当是师兄也想借机观察对方的虚实，等摸清了底细再动手不迟。
长街上重新安静下来，两拨人各怀心思，谁也没有先开口。
就在这时候，一声沉闷的爆鸣从城池东北方向炸响。
紧接着是一股剧烈的神魂波动，如同水波般从那个方向荡开，扫过整座城池。
那波动中夹杂着霸烈无匹的战意，以及一种让人头皮发麻的阴冷气息。
姜玄脸色微变，转头看向波动传来的方向。
“那边有战斗！”
他的话音还没落下，叶天澜已经动了。
身形一闪便化作一道金色残影，背后拖拽出金龙之影，朝着东北方向疾掠而去。
洛珺仙紧随其后，白鸢剑已然出鞘半寸，凛冽剑光在夜色中划出一道冰蓝的弧线。

姜玄看着那道金色残影消失在巷道尽头，眼神闪烁了一下，随即朝身后的师弟们挥了挥手。
“跟上去看看。”
七道青色剑光腾空而起，紧追着那道金色残影的方向飞去。
……
城池东北角，一座废弃的演武场上。
魏观一刀劈退面前的人影，虎口被震得隐隐发麻。
在他脚边横七竖八倒着几具尸体，可那些尸体没有一具是他杀的。
他的神色暗沉，几番交手之后心中已经有了判断。
叶天澜果然没有感知错，这里的确是有邪祟存在，并且还猖獗至极。
他不过是经过此地，一群被噬魂蛭寄生了神魂的修士就突然从暗处杀了出来。
看其身上的服饰杂乱无章，各个势力的都有。
唯一的共同点是他们的眼神空洞，呆滞，像是一潭死水，什么情绪都映不出来。
他狂暴迅猛的刀罡劈下去，就连城池也会被劈出百米宽的沟壑，可对方却连躲都不带躲的。
就站在那里，硬吃一刀也要找准机会为他带来伤势。
肩胛骨被劈开，血肉翻卷，连骨头茬子都露出来了，可那人的脸上依旧没有任何表情。
没有痛苦，没有恐惧，甚至连最基本的本能反应都没有。
短暂被刀罡的冲击力震退了十几步，站稳之后又面无表情地扑上来，像是被人用线提着的木偶。
content_en:
The other party said that they had several friends. Whether these friends were true or false, it at least meant that there were their accomplices nearby.
It is not wise to act rashly before knowing the opponent's number and strength.
"If that's the case, then we can be considered on the same journey." Jiang Xuan had a gentle smile on his face.
"If you two don't mind, can some of our fellow apprentices also help with the search? There are many people with equal efforts. If there is really something evil hiding here, it would be best if we can take care of each other."
Ye Tianlan glanced at him and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.
"Okay, then Brother Lao Jiang will be here."
Jiang Xuan nodded and smiled, then turned around to greet the junior brothers behind him.
The moment he turned around, a sneer flashed in his eyes.
Looking out for each other?
He just wanted to keep this couple under his nose to prevent them from ruining his affairs in the dark.
As for the other people, when they saw their senior brother voluntarily offering to go with them, they just thought it was the senior brother who also wanted to take the opportunity to observe the other party's reality, and it would not be too late to take action after finding out the details.
The long street became quiet again. The two groups of people had their own thoughts, and no one spoke first.
At this moment, a dull explosion exploded from the northeast of the city.
Immediately afterwards, there was a violent wave of soul, swinging from that direction like a wave of water, sweeping across the entire city.
The fluctuations were mixed with an unparalleled fighting spirit and a cold aura that made people's scalp numb.
Jiang Xuan's expression changed slightly, and he turned to look in the direction of the wave.
"There's a fight over there!"
Before he could finish his words, Ye Tianlan had already moved.
The figure turned into a golden afterimage in a flash, and the shadow of the golden dragon was dragged out from behind, rushing towards the northeast.
Luo Junxian followed closely behind, the white kite sword already half an inch out of its sheath, and the cold sword light drew an icy blue arc in the night.
Jiang Xuan watched the golden afterimage disappear at the end of the alley, his eyes flickered, and then he waved to the junior brothers behind him.
"Follow up and have a look."
Seven cyan sword lights rose into the air and flew in the direction of the golden afterimage.
…
In the northeast corner of the city, there is an abandoned martial arts field.
Wei Guan slashed away the figure in front of him with a knife, and the tiger's mouth was slightly numb from the shock.
There were several corpses lying scattered at his feet, but none of those corpses were killed by him.
His expression was dark, and he had already made a judgment in his mind after several fights.
Ye Tianlan's perception was indeed correct. Evil spirits did exist here, and they were extremely rampant.
He just passed by this place, and a group of monks whose souls were parasitized by soul-eating leeches suddenly came out of the darkness and killed them.
The clothes on his body were all in disarray, and they belonged to various factions.
The only thing they have in common is that their eyes are empty and dull, like a pool of stagnant water, with no emotion reflected.
His violent and swift slashes with the sword would create a hundred-meter-wide ravine in the city, but the opponent didn't even try to hide.
Just stand there, take a knife and find the right opportunity to injure him.
The shoulder blade was split open, the flesh and blood rolled around, and even the bone stubble was exposed, but the man's face still showed no expression.
There was no pain, no fear, not even the most basic instinctive reaction.
He was briefly knocked back more than a dozen steps by the impact of the sword. After he stood firm, he rushed forward expressionlessly, like a puppet being held up by strings.
